# antigravity-priority v1.2.10

## Release Notes

- **Fix automatic schedule write display in system diagnostics**: Resolved an issue where the "Last Apply Health" KPI card and the "Latest Execution & Desensitized Audit" stream in the diagnostics panel only matched manual apply runs. Automatic schedule write-back executions (`auto_apply`) are now fully tracked and rendered with real-time health badges, timestamps, success/skip counts, and desensitized audit logs.
- **Unified write health and execution telemetry**: Ensured full contract consistency between manual immediate write-backs (`manual_apply`) and background scheduled runs (`auto_apply`) across audit messages, change counters, and status badges.
